input.free_text_description: This system is a content management platform that serves Content Creator, Admin roles. The platform provides capabilities for default idempotence, idempotence, retention. Secondary concerns include microservices functionality.

user_stories.story: As a Content Creator, I want to interact with operation functionality, so that I can accomplish my operation-related tasks.
As a Content Creator, I want to use default idempotence capabilities, so that I can perform essential business operations.
As a Content Creator, I want to use idempotence capabilities, so that I can perform essential business operations.
As a Content Creator, I want to use retention capabilities, so that I can perform essential business operations.
As a Content Creator, I want to access the system through a well-defined interface, so that I can perform my tasks efficiently.
